title: Resilience, Security & Operability
description: Circuit breakers, rate limiting, token buckets, TLS termination, zero-trust security, and observability stacks.
content:
# Resilience, Security & Operability

## 1. Resilience & Fault Tolerance
- **Circuit Breaker Pattern**: Monitors error rates to prevent cascading failure (Closed -> Open -> Half-Open).
- **Bulkheading**: Isolates resources (thread pools, connection pools) so failures in one service do not drain capacity.
- **Graceful Degradation**: Fallback to cached or read-only data when upstream services fail.

## 2. Security Fundamentals
- **Rate Limiting**: Token Bucket, Leaky Bucket, Sliding Window Counter.
- **Identity & Auth**: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, JWTs, Mutual TLS (mTLS) for microservices inter-service auth.
- **Zero-Trust Network Architecture**: Never trust, always verify every request regardless of location.
